text:
mike: fyi found what looks like a service token in staging stdout from a batch-worker run. grepped the logs and saw a bearer token inline. not sure if it's a temp token or an env leak. cc @andrea @sam

andrea: thanks — can you paste a sanitized snippet and the service name? first actions: redact logs and consider rotation depending on scope.

mike: sanitized snippet: `2026-03-17T14:02:41Z batch-worker INFO sending request to payment-api Authorization: Bearer sk_test_[redacted]`
service: analytics-ingest (staging). i removed the debug print from startup and redeployed. logs before 14:00 may have leaked.

sam: which process prints env? we recently added a debug helper in startup.sh that does `printenv` when DEBUG=1. did you run with DEBUG on?

mike: yep that was it — DEBUG was enabled in the staging job. i've already pushed a fix to stop printing env.

andrea: even if staging, rotate the token. limited scope helps but rotate and check whether the raw token is stored anywhere (vault, k8s secret, s3 backups). also redact the existing logs asap.

irene: for rotation approvals: who signs off on emergency rotations for staging? @josh? also suggest running the log-scrub tool: `log-scrub --pattern 'sk_[A-Za-z0-9]+' --rewrite staging --from 2026-03-17T13:00` to rewrite any occurrences.

security-bot: Policy note: non-prod token exposure requires rotation per token-exposure-runbook. see https://go/repo/security/token-policy — rotate immediately and file an incident note.

josh: i approve emergency rotate for this staging token. rotate, limit scope to read-only, and switch to KMS envelope-wrapping where possible. file a short incident doc in #incidents when done.

mike: rotating now. quick question before i finish: for staging should we import the new token into HSM-managed key-wrap or store in Vault transit? which is the recommended approach?

andrea: for non-prod staging, Vault transit is acceptable and faster. for prod or customer-sensitive tokens prefer HSM/KMS-wrapped keys with strict decrypt IAM. also update the service to fetch secrets from vault at runtime and never log them.

sam: after rotate, i'll run the log-redact job and add a check in the runbook to ensure DEBUG prints are gated behind an explicit feature flag and not enabled in CI or scheduled jobs.

mike: done — rotated the token, updated startup (removed printenv), kicked the log-scrub job, and opened PR #8421 to remove the debug helper. filing incident note now and pinging @sec-approvers for an audit.

josh: thanks — mark resolved once the incident doc is live. :thumbsup:
